rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for requiring something as a condition or rule.

example.english: The company can stipulate that staff must wear name badges.
example.traditional: 公司規定員工返工要戴名牌。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 kwai1 ding6 jyun4 gung1 faan1 gung1 jiu3 daai3 ming4 paai4

rows.note: Use this especially when a contract or written agreement explicitly lays out the condition.

example.english: The lease will stipulate that tenants cannot keep pets.
example.traditional: 份租約訂明租客唔可以養寵物。
example.jyutping: fan6 zou1 joek3 ding3 ming4 zou1 haak3 m4 ho2 ji5 joeng5 cung2 mat6

rows.note: Use this in casual speech when stressing that the condition has been clearly stated to the other party.

example.english: We stipulate from the start that anyone arriving late has to pay for themselves.
example.traditional: 我哋一開始就講明，遲到要自己畀錢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 hoi1 ci2 zau6 gong2 ming4 ci4 dou3 jiu3 zi6 gei2 bei2 cin4
